M-TIMELINE-BEHAVIOR.Purpose: Declarative action orchestration as a Behavior: sequence, parallelism, conditions, looping, and reactive-slot assignment, without owning the behavior algorithms or property-held values.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Timeline static factory builds inert action definitions and creates TimelineBehavior.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: TimelineBehavior provides Behavior lifecycle integration; TimelinePlayer drives an independent execution tree of ITimelineAction instances.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: SetAction uses IPropertyRef and the actual slot occupant to observe OnComplete and Changing; other actions implement Wait, WaitUntil, Call, Sequence, Parallel, If and While.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Value interpolation and target adaptation belong to primitive behaviors and SequenceBehavior.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Property activation, update scheduling and registry ownership belong to the Widget/FVP property-owner lifecycle and runtime services.
Scope.SCP-OUT-003: BindRef/WatchRef subscription policies are separate from Timeline execution.

Principles.PRIN-001: Timeline controls the ordering and termination of actions, not the lifetime or algorithm of behaviors assigned into external property slots.
Principles.PRIN-002: Action success (Completed) and interruption (Interrupted) are internal results; Behavior.OnComplete is the normal end-of-updating notification for either outcome and for explicit Stop.

Requirements.REQ-001: Timeline.Create returns an Inactive TimelineBehavior; creation does not execute actions. Assignment to a Widget/FVP reactive property activates and schedules it through the ordinary Behavior lifecycle; no separate Timeline.Play or scheduler.
Requirements.REQ-002: TimelineBehavior starts updating via StartUpdating and stops via StopUpdating; OnComplete is emitted when a running timeline finishes, is interrupted, or is explicitly stopped, so BehaviorUpdater unsubscribes. Active idle instances do not automatically replay.
Requirements.REQ-003: Sequence starts its children in order, advances on Completed and propagates Interrupted; Parallel starts children concurrently and completes only after all Completed, propagating any interruption. Empty composites complete immediately.
Requirements.REQ-004: Call invokes its callback once and completes synchronously; Wait waits a finite nonnegative duration; WaitUntil polls a predicate; If selects its branch once; While reevaluates the predicate before each iteration and starts at most one iteration per update tick.
Requirements.REQ-005: Set accepts typed or untyped IPropertyRef plus compatible Behavior, assigns a fresh runtime clone, and awaits OnComplete of the actual installed Behavior. SemEquals no-op assignments instead wait for the retained slot occupant without generating synthetic OnComplete.
Requirements.REQ-006: Set listens for replacement through IPropertyRef.Changing; real replacement before observed OnComplete interrupts the action. Its own initial assignment is not treated as replacement. Set manages its own subscriptions, without BindRef/WatchRef dependencies.
Requirements.REQ-007: Interrupted children propagate interruption to the root; interruption prevents subsequent dependent actions but does not undo external effects. Behavior.OnComplete remains a lifecycle signal, not proof of action success.
Requirements.REQ-008: Stop and Reset terminate the execution tree and unsubscribe Timeline-owned handlers, without resetting, stopping or reclaiming behaviors already assigned into property slots. StopUpdating emits the standard OnComplete if updating was active.
Requirements.REQ-009: Each playback clones its action blueprint and has isolated mutable execution state; cloning a TimelineBehavior does not clone captured property owners or delegates. A completed instance stays Active and idle; replay requires a separately activated instance.
Requirements.REQ-010: Actions handle synchronous completion, nested callbacks, interruption and repeated Stop without replay or duplicate downstream side effects; instant actions within Sequence may drain in a single tick, while instant While bodies cannot cause an unbounded same-tick loop.
Requirements.REQ-011: Set completion strictly depends on receiving OnComplete, even when a retained semantically equal occupant is already idle. No value equality, IsUpdating polling or synthetic success substitutes for the event; callers must account for never-emitting behaviors.

Inputs.IN-002: deltaTime: float from BehaviorUpdater through TimelineBehavior.Update.
Inputs.IN-003: IPropertyRef slot and Behavior blueprint for Set.

Outputs.OUT-001: Internal action outcome: Running, Completed or Interrupted (plus Ready before start).
Outputs.OUT-002: Behavior lifecycle: Active with IsUpdating false after termination; OnComplete emitted when a running update cycle stops.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Call callbacks, property assignment through IPropertyRef, and action-owned event subscriptions while executing.
